question: The sides of a triangle are 68 cm, 31 cm, and 87 cm. What is the length of its altitude corresponding to the side with a length of 31 cm?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Semi-perimeter (s) = (68 + 31 + 87) ÷ 2 = 186 ÷ 2 = 93 cm.

Area = √(s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)) = √(93 × 25 × 62 × 6).

Area = √(31 × 3 × 5² × 31 × 2 × 3 × 2) = 31 × 3 × 2 × 5 = 930 cm².

Altitude (h) corresponding to side 31 cm = (2 × Area) ÷ 31.

h = (2 × 930) ÷ 31 = 60 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 60 cm.**
